svg.title: Blueprint sheet 7, the hen: a full basket of eggs is not the same as the hen that lays them

g.text: is not the same as the hen that lays them
eat the hen: a big dinner
looks full for a few days.
by the time it is empty,
ONE WAY TO RANK A MOVE
in real life the hen is hard
to see: good soil, skills, trust.
a living blueprint for a world
